text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was finally the last night of summer 
camp. Rhein Kraft and the others were 
enjoying the traditional all-school 
barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, so delicious~~~! I really do prefer 
baked carrots with a sweeter sauce after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Messiah-san! Your plate's completely 
empty. Wanna go get seconds together once 
I finish this?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... for me... ...I've already 
received plenty.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Really? Don't be shy, Messiah! You pushed 
yourself quite hard during the training 
camp, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Eat as much as you train to build your 
body! That's the fundamentals, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Once summer's over, there's a big race 
right around the corner, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: October has the "Shuka Sho," after all...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The final crown of the Triple Tiara... 
The race where we'll clash once again!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm not going to lose, everyone! Not 
to Heart-san, not to Messiah-san, and not 
to—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...You know, about that matter...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Craft. I'm not entering the 
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? W-What do you mean!?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...To be precise, she *can't* race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I can't enter... Can't run...!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Throughout this summer, we kept training 
while monitoring the situation and had the 
doctors examine it plenty of times, but—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the beginning of summer, that 
weird feeling in my leg... The pain just 
wouldn't go away.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! Does that mean... an injury—!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. Even if I can get through daily 
life and my everyday training just fine—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It seems that entering races that put too 
much strain on her body will be difficult 
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario... So, that was it...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Craft, don't make that face.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I got hurt. ...And it 
frustrates me that I can't run in the 
Shuka Sho, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely not letting things end like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Like hell I'll let it end here.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Cesario...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"To become the champion among Tiara 
Umamusume, forging history and passing the 
torch to the next generation."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
My path is still continuing. And I'll make 
sure it goes on...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting. For the day I can run 
with Cesario again... For the day we can 
compete again, I'll be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. But it's not like I have any 
intention of leisurely stopping in my 
tracks, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The supreme ruler among the Tiara 
Umamusume... The one who will shine upon 
the queen's throne is none other than 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to try and catch up to me, 
then I'll just pull away with everything 
I've got.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
First, I shall place the crown of the 
Shuka Sho upon this head of mine, of 
course.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Heh... Yeah, please do.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I ran away.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
From that lively place where bright 
laughter echoed. From those girls 
radiating brilliant light. Even from the 
dazzling, twinkling starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I ran, and ran, and ran... and kept on 
running away.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to be found. I didn't want 
the light to shine on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Look at me now—so fragile, so unsightly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
After her sensational performances in the 
Oka Sho and the NHK Mile Cup, Rhein Kraft 
carried herself with the true presence of 
a new Mile Queen—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
From the "Oaks", she went on to challenge 
American GⅠs and achieved a historic, 
grand feat— Cesario-san—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Having proven their outstanding 
brilliance, they stand today... ...at the 
center of the era as Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"And Daring Heart-san, who put on a fierce 
run in the NHK Mile Cup just like 
Craft-san."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not at all overshadowed by the two 
radiating auroras, she is overflowing with 
a will striving for the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Craft. I'm not entering the 
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...To be precise, she *can't* race.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Back then... when I heard about 
Cesario-san's injury and her skipping the 
Shuka Sho, I...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
About her. About Cesario-san, just a 
little. ...No, perhaps, from the bottom of 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I was jealous.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Because she, with justifiable reason, 
would be excused even if she didn't stand 
in that arena."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Talent, ability, resolve, willpower— all 
tested to the absolute limit, and on top 
of that—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“To that place where only the cruel 
reality is shown: that there is only one 
winner, and everyone else is a loser!”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...To think I'd be allowed not to stand.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You think so—?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Kh, you idiot...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, idiot, idiot!! That's just the 
worst...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That's... just so...—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...The 'Shuka Sho' is the last one...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara races are about to end. 
This is my final chance to avenge my 
mother...!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I have to show it. ...I must show it!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing Rhein Kraft-san, Cesario-san, 
and Daring Heart-san—surpassing them all—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Overwhelming... power—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...How on earth are we supposed to do 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Someone like me... how could I...?
